mapper.insert: insert into user_agent_session (session_id, user_id, title, status, last_task_id, message_count, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{lastTaskId}, #{messageCount}, now(), now(), #{userId}, #{userId})
mapper.select: select * from user_agent_session where session_id = #{sessionId} for update
select * from user_agent_session where session_id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId}
